verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 exposes programmatic management interfaces such as Redfish on its BMC, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.nvidia.com all returned 404. The llms.txt documentation index is an adjacent AI-friendly docs feature, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
